svg.aria-label: An org, staging, holds a GVC, my-gvc, drawn as a panel containing the workload my-app. Arrows labeled spans fan out from the GVC to three locations: aws-us-east-1 with the AWS logo, gcp-us-central1 with the Google Cloud logo, and my-hardware with the Kubernetes logo. Each location holds one deployment of my-app, drawn as two replica chips, replica 01 and replica 02. You create the workload once, inside the GVC, and Control Plane runs it in every location the GVC spans, at the replica count you set. One org, one GVC, one workload, three locations, and two replicas in each.
